units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>לא קרינו וכ׳</he> we have omitted to recite &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:4">Ib. III, 4</cite> <he>לא … ולא וכ׳</he> neither before nor after.

Nidd. 5ᵃ לא אין להן וכ׳, no; it means &c., v. לַאו; a. v. fr.—וְלֹא indeed not? Ḥull. 4ᵇ ולא והכתיב וכ׳ indeed not (is it so that the verb הֵסִית never refers to persuasion by speech)? Do we not read &c.?; a. v. fr.—(מִצְוַת) לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה a prohibitory law, opp. עֲשֵׂה, a positive command; v. לַאו.
<cite ref="Berakhot 35a:21">Ber. 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ב׳ ברכה</he> without pronouncing a benediction; a. v. fr.—<he>והוא שלא</he>, v. <cite ref="E00178"><he>הוּא</he></cite>.
